lastCompletedStory.title: Renomear a superficie digitada do binario (help, usage, --version) e desancorar o gate agents-md do prefixo aposentado

nextStoryContext: This session found the implementation for US-002 already committed (HEAD was cf84895f, a well-formed `feat: US-002 - ...` commit) by a prior session that crashed before pushing/writing worker-report.json -- no code was re-implemented; this session independently re-verified all 4 story-specific AC oracles (help/usage cam-free + gship present, --version prints `gateship X.Y.Z`, agents-md gate CAM_CMD_RE desanchored to `/^(?:cam|gship|gateship)\s+/` with the named durable test present, and the 5-contract invariance pin) plus the full gate spine (typecheck clean, bun test 5957 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all all-green) before completing the tail of the protocol. index.ts's typed-invocation surface (all --help output, usage: strings, --version) now prints `gship` for commands-to-type and `gateship <ver>` for the product/version identity; the 5 ADR-0054-pinned internal contracts (CAM_ env vars, .cam- state files, the `tmux -L cam` socket, /cam- slash commands, sentinel strings) are untouched and pinned by AC4 against a live main comparison, not a frozen count -- do not rename any of those five in a story that isn't explicitly scoped to do so. scripts/validate-agents-md.ts's CAM_CMD_RE now accepts cam|gship|gateship as the invocation prefix, so the gate keeps checking the still-cam-prefixed claims in CLAUDE.md/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md/.claude/agents/*.md until those docs are renamed in a later story (that later doc-rename story does not need to touch this regex again). scripts/build-release.sh's two --version smoke EXPECTED strings already match the new `gateship X.Y.Z` shape. test/version.test.ts's file-size ceiling was raised 91->92 with a tracker-ref'd `_ref` entry (CAM-460/US-002).
